newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine credit risk indicators fall in Jan-Feb.
newsitem.headline: Argentine credit risk indicators fall in Jan-Feb.

text.p: Argentina's credit risk indicators, such as account closures and bankruptcies, showed a general drop in the first two months of 1997, the private credit risk consultancy Fidelitas said Monday.
Current accounts closed due to bounced checks fell by 47 percent in January and February compared to the same period of 1996.

In January, courts close for vacations, but February registered a decline in court-ordered company closings to just 93, continuing the steady decline since October last year, and preventative bankruptcies totalled 100 versus 137 in December.
But Fidelitas warned that the large variations indicated that "the biggest reductions seem to be due more to Central Bank administrative reasons than conditions in the market."
